periods.summary: Dargus commands the League's elite assault force deployed close to the Quedland border: thirty thousand troops, more than five thousand Blazers, tanks, aircraft and Mage-Knights, with a larger encirclement sealing escape routes. He deliberately stations the army near the border so it can invade quickly if Vermillion loses and because he believes Or-Gaule's side cannot afford to challenge the League directly. When Naseem appears as Quedland's envoy and demands withdrawal, Dargus speaks as if offering recruitment to stall for time, then has eighty-five tanks fire on him without warning. He accepts that killing an envoy could cost his post but judges eliminating the Desert Reaper worth it. The bombardment fails; Naseem reforms from sand, slaughters the advance troops, dries Mage-Knights with Mictlan Tormenta, and breaks the army. Dargus refuses to order immediate retreat because he is waiting for Carlo Bertoni, the army's joker. Carlo's defeat and death leave no hope, and Dargus orders full retreat, after which Naseem's quicksand collapse destroys much of the assault force.

key_events.summary: Commands the failed border operation and orders retreat after Carlo's death.
